class_id: a section the extractor could not read is recorded as one the document does not print
feature: every empty extractor section whose reason the filing persister records (field_extraction_failures, today promoters and peer_companies), every document type, both segments
symptom: the empty-section reason always used rule_id NOT_PRINTED, so a FAILED check ('check_failed: []') or a section found but unread ('peer_comparison_table_found_but_no_peer_rows_parsed') reads as 'the document does not carry it'. A reader miss then looks settled and the extractor defect behind it is never routed for a fix (OD-62 gives EXTRACTION_FAILED and NOT_PRINTED opposite treatment). Generic test: count NOT_PRINTED rows whose cause is a failed check or a found-but-unread reason; any row is a member.
first_seen: 2026-10-01, ipodhan_staging read-only: 17 of 87 NOT_PRINTED rows across 12 IPOs are reader misses (15 failed checks, e.g. ss-retail-ltd PRICE_BAND_AD promoter_names 'check_failed: []'; 2 found-but-unread, moneyview-ltd and paramount-syntex-ltd RHP peer tables). #1246 (B').
fix_prs: #1246 PR (fix/1246-empty-section-reason): emptySectionRuleId in filing-persister.ts gives NOT_PRINTED only to a passing check whose reason is on the stated-absence allowlist; everything else fails closed to EXTRACTION_FAILED. audit-field-extraction-failures.mjs reports NOT_PRINTED as absences, outside --fail-over. The 17 existing rows are relabelled by the next read of their documents (a new extractor version or document), not by hand. #1420 design point 3: emptySectionRuleId reads the ONE shared list scraper/src/config/stated-absence-reasons.json (the list answer_states.py reads), so the pattern misses #1412 still listed (peer_comparison_table_not_in_document, peer_comparison_table_absent_only_kpi_table_present, our_promoters_statement_not_on_cover) are EXTRACTION_FAILED.
